entities.name: Restored Hanthawaddy Kingdom
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Kingdom that ruled lower burma and parts of upper burma from 1740 to 1757, growing out of a rebellion by the mon people, succeeded in restoring the fallen mon-speaking kingdom of hanthawaddy and ended the 266-year-old toungoo dynasty Founded 1740.
